Hello Deposit Team members.

We want to re-establish our clear routine processes. Specifically for deposit requests, we need to go via a series that includes initial receipt in Accounts then to HR and to you, Deposit Staff for the ultimate approvals and follow-through.

We aim to handle these with speed to avoid undue delays in our workflow.

I hope to receive your clarifications as well.

Thanks,
[first-name lastinitial]
